cn: ⭐AEE - 外觀編輯拓展 更新
新增線上衣櫃容量檢測(180kb)，超出時會禁止保存
新增在設定頁能看到衣櫃的容量(目前設置180KB)
修改衣櫃服裝排序功能，現在能使用拖曳方式
修改衣櫃匯出服裝時，現在能選單一服裝而非整個衣櫃
修改讓互動按紐穩定加載
新增缺少的翻譯，現在支援遊戲的7國語言
⭐BC - 快捷互动插件 更新
修改收藏動作頁面，現在對全員互動
en: Added online wardrobe capacity check (180KB); saving will be blocked when exceeded
Added wardrobe capacity display in settings page (currently set to 180KB)
Modified wardrobe outfit sorting feature, now supports drag-and-drop
Modified wardrobe outfit export feature, now allows selecting a single outfit instead of the entire wardrobe
Added missing translations; now supports all 7 in-game languages
Modified to stabilize interaction button loading
Modified favorite actions page, now supports interaction with all members
